items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: Happy. Happy. Good snare drum, man.

ctx.x: Do they have any good snare drum in the street?
Happy. Happy. Good snare drum, man.

You know, I'm tired of hearing the Saints, but any time I heard him play that in the street, that was something. You know, the leaves. He'd build that up. Boy, he could really play it. Ooh, Happy. Happy, yeah. Happy.
